every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 keeps its explanatory UI card anchored in frames 4 and 7 alongside the 3D scene, whereas Site 1 drops the text card completely in frames 4 and 7 leaving awkward, unlabeled transition gaps.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D mechanical press, anchor rack, and 7-lane gate assembly across frames 1 to 9 to clearly visualize token compression and harness routing.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature identical, well-crafted 3D industrial machinery with beveled edges, matte metallic materials, and grounded contact shadows on the dark grid floor across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While sharing the same clean typography and left-docked card layout, Site 2 maintains consistent UI card visibility in frames 4 and 7 instead of letting the layout vanish mid-section like Site 1.

overall.reason: Site 2 delivers the exact same strong 3D mechanical metaphor and clean technical typography as Site 1 while keeping the explanatory text cards consistently composed during scroll transitions in frames 4 and 7.
